notes: After a strong T1 (Maintenance Access steal of Stoke the Embers) the runner spent T2-T10 almost entirely clicking for credits and paying 2 to clear tags (2-3 tag removals per turn), installed nothing but Afterimage, drew only twice, and never contested Server 2 while Tomorrow's Headline (T5) and Witch Hunt (T8) were advanced and scored. T9 facechecked Server 3 into a second Ping with 4 credits and no answer, and T10 ran into Behold!/Increased Drop Rates for more tags.

Won through good remote steals (Hybrid Release T9 through Ivik/Tatu-Bola, Yagi-Uda T14, Sericulture T19) and Archives, but sat at 0-3 credits from T12 on and repeatedly ran HQ into Phoneutria unbroken (T17-T19), trashing own Cookbook, Botulus and other cards. T16 paid 3 to pump Odore against Phoneutria and then broke nothing, and T15 facechecked R&D Diviner at 3 credits.

After bouncing off Capacitor on Server 2 on T2, the runner clicked for credits every single turn T3-T11 (to 48 credits), never drawing, installing a breaker or running, while Server 2 scored Next Big Thing (T7), Kingmaking (T9) and Remastered Edition (T12). No coherent plan beyond a T5 Tiered Subscription trash.

Solid R&D pressure through Tatu-Bola and later Karuna with Rising Tide/Odore, Devil Charm and Mystic Maemi, winning on T15 with an Archives Yagi-Uda pickup plus R&D steal. Minor issues: T7 naked-remote run into Urtica Cipher cost 3 cards, and several turns (T5, T10, T11) clicked credits into a full grip forcing discards.

Great T1 Jailbreak double steal and good Tread Lightly steal of Freedom of Information on T6, but T5 and T7 were spent clicking for credits/clearing tags with 7-13 credits against a 1-credit corp, and T2 facechecked HQ into Ping with 6 credits. Won T9 off Post-Truth Dividend through Doomscroll damage.

Installed Odore T1 and then, after one Hafrun ETR on T4, clicked for credits every turn to 36 credits, never drawing or installing another breaker. The corp scored two Project Yagi-Uda (T5, T6) and Sericulture (T8) from Server 2 and Hybrid Release (T10) from a lightly iced Server 3 with no challenge.

Sensible game: early HQ steal of Artificial Cryptocrash through Paywall, Daily Casts economy, Rigging Up/Self-modifying Code into Gauss to steal Next Big Thing from Server 1 on T8, and R&D win T10. Minor slip: T6 facechecked Server 1 into Capacitor with no fracter installed, and T3 ended at 0 credits.

Strong start (Artificial Cryptocrash T1, Remastered Edition T2 from R&D) but then T4-T5, T8-T9 and T11-T12 were pure credit clicking up to 32 credits with a full grip and a working Gauss, never pressuring HQ or R&D. Won anyway via naked-remote Kingmaking (T10) and Oracle Thinktank (T14), but the long passive stretch is bizarre.

Good early aggression (See How They Run, Regenesis, Longevity Serum stolen from Server 1 by T7), but after Knowledge Seeker stopped the T11 run the runner clicked credits to 26 for six turns, never installing a code-gate answer or using the grip (Bladderwort/Neurospike trashed the unused cards). Corp then scored Lotus Haze T13 and T15, Longevity Serum T17 and See How They Run T19 from the same server unchallenged.

Fast T8 win with two Lotus Haze steals from Server 3, Katorga Breakout into See How They Run, and a final HQ steal. Main mistake: on T6 the runner installed Abaasy and clicked credits instead of running the freshly installed card in Server 3 (whose ice had never rezzed), and Longevity Serum was scored from there on T7; T2 naked advanced-card run into Urtica Cipher also cost 3 cards.

Won T19 with steady R&D runs through Hafrun, but ran into Urtica Ciphers on T2 and T3 (losing Boi-tata), and on T8 and T12 ran HQ at 0-1 credits into known Saisentan, eating 4 net damage each time and risking flatline. Economy sat near 0 for most of the game, and T14 ran R&D instead of the newly installed Server 4 card that scored See How They Run on T15.

Competent Gauss/Unity HQ-R&D pressure (Oracle Thinktank T1, Cryptocrash T4, Next Big Thing T9) and a final T13 steal of Kingmaking through four unrezzed ice. Oddity: kept running R&D into F2P (T7, T9, T13) that bounced Gauss each time, and let Artificial Cryptocrash score from Server 1 on T11 while poor.

Took 4 net damage passing Saisentan on T5 (Katorga) and Anemone on T9 (Chastushka) and then jacked out both times instead of accessing, and on T11 ran Server 3/Archives while Lotus Haze sat in Server 4 to score T12. From T14-T17 and T21-T22 it clicked for credits to 23 with the corp at 6 points instead of hitting R&D/HQ, and lost to a Hybrid Release on T23.

Spent all credits on T1 (Afterimage, Window of Opportunity into Ping) and never recovered, spending T3, T6-T8 paying 2-credit tag removals and clicking credits with no installs. Never contested Server 1, which scored Freedom of Information (T2), Witch Hunt (T6) and the winning Freedom of Information (T11) behind a single Ping.

Won T10 with good HQ pressure (FoI, Post-Truth Dividend) and a final double R&D steal of Stoke the Embers, but repeatedly re-ran HQ into the known Behold! taking 2 tags each time (T4-T6) and wasted T9/T10 Maintenance Access runs by jacking out. Never checked Server 1, which scored Tomorrow's Headline twice (T5, T9) and brought the corp to 6.

On T6 the runner made four R&D runs while Hybrid Release had just installed a card into an unprotected Server 2, and that card (Sericulture Expansion) was the winning score on T8. T3, T5 and T7 were pure credit clicks (to 16 credits) while the corp scored Flower Sermon and Hybrid Release from Server 1.

Persistent R&D pressure through Funhouse with Sipa swaps, Gauss and Unity won T18 (Oracle Thinktank, Kingmaking x2, Cryptocrash) while the corp never scored. Minor oddities: repeatedly taking Funhouse tags then paying to clear them, and installing Daeg on T13 at 0 credits.

Clicked for credits nearly every turn from T2 to T15, reaching 59 credits without installing a breaker until Rising Tide on T11, while Project Yagi-Uda (T6), Hybrid Release (T7), Sericulture Expansion (T11) and the winning Sericulture (T17) scored. The only real activity was a T7 run burst and a T12 Karuna run that was jacked out after taking 4 net.

Good tempo: The Price into Stargate, Utae through Diviner for Sericulture and Yagi-Uda on T4, Hybrid Release through Ivik on T6, and the T12 Yagi-Uda win. Minor issues: T10 facechecked Vicsek on Server 2 at 4 credits and T11 hit Urtica Cipher losing Rising Tide (recovered).

Reached 5 points by T7 (Next Big Thing via Nanuq, naked Artificial Cryptocrash), then clicked for credits every turn T8-T15 up to 54 credits with no breaker for Klevetnik and no draws. Server 1 scored Remastered Edition T8 and T10, Oracle Thinktank T14 and the winning Remastered Edition T16 completely uncontested.
